novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a new mechanistic relationship: “belief-vs-fact errors are partly errors of temporal indexing” and a distinct “temporal-validity direction” binds an item-state to current versus stale validity and can be steered independently of state content. Searches for “LLM temporal-validity direction current stale belief activation steering,” “time-indexed beliefs LLM probing,” and “outdated knowledge context conflict representation engineering” found the closest precedents in “Steering Knowledge Selection Behaviours in LLMs via SAE-Based Representation Engineering,” which detects and steers context-memory conflicts involving outdated information, and “Monitoring Latent World States in Language Models with Propositional Probes,” which decodes propositionally bound world states but not their temporal validity. Moving from those works to explicitly factorizing state-value from current/past validity and interpreting belief-report errors as failures of that binding is a substantive natural extension and multi-step integration, rather than a wholly new intervention paradigm, supporting standard novelty.
